name: audiodn
shortDescription: A hosted place for agents to store, play, and preview audio — plus the APIs to put it in your app.
description: AudioDN is a hosted audio library for coding agents: store files you generate or find, then play, preview, and deliver them. The plugin also teaches secure upload, transcoding, and playback so you do not invent S3/FFmpeg pipelines or leak API keys.
longDescription: AudioDN (Audio Delivery Network) is hosted audio infrastructure. Add it to a Cursor bot or any app when you need a durable place to keep audio that agents come across — generated clips, downloads, voice notes, podcasts, UGC — then play, preview, and reuse those tracks. This plugin wires the hosted AudioDN MCP (docs without a key; live catalog/upload/playback tools after you paste an API Access key), teaches the correct security boundaries and API sequence (upload session → per-track create → processing readiness → play session or signed delivery), and is the AudioDN plugin for AI coding tools, not a separate product.

ADN_API_KEY.title: AudioDN API Access key
ADN_API_KEY.description: Optional. Mint a server-side API Access key at https://account.audiodeliverynetwork.com (Settings → API Keys). Knowledge tools work without it. Set this to list collections, store audio from the agent, mint play sessions, and preview tracks. Never put this key in client or component code.
